'''Brigitte Wolf''' (born 7 May 1967)<ref>{{cite web |url=http://pwt.org/home/runners_show.asp?runner_id=56 |title=Brigitte Wolf |work=Park World Tour |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050119120716/http://pwt.org/home/runners_show.asp?runner_id=56 |archive-date=2005-01-19}}</ref> is a [[Switzerland|Swiss]] [[orienteering]] [[Competition|competitor]]<ref name=ok77>[http://www.ok77.fi/old/esittely/grupper/elit/esittely_wolf.htm Profile: Brigitte Wolf] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20060109013021/http://www.ok77.fi/old/esittely/grupper/elit/esittely_wolf.htm |date=9 January 2006 }} (Retrieved on 22 December 2007)</ref> and [[ski mountaineer]].

== Selected results ==

=== Orienteering ===
Wolf is [[World Orienteering Championships|Relay World Champion]] as a member of the Swiss winning team in 2003,<ref name="woc">[http://old.orientering.no/resultater/vmres.asp "World Orienteering Championship, senior statistics 1966-2006"] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110823154017/http://old.orientering.no/resultater/vmres.asp |date=23 August 2011 }} (Retrieved on 2 December 2007)</ref><ref name=iof-woc2003>{{cite web |url=http://orienteering.org/events/?event_id=34 |title=World Orienteering Championships 2003 |publisher=[[International Orienteering Federation]] |accessdate=19 November 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120920090215/http://orienteering.org/events/?event_id=34 |archive-date=20 September 2012 |url-status=dead}}</ref> as well as having a bronze medal from 1997.  She also obtained bronze in the Long distance World Championship in 2003.<ref name=iof-woc2003/>

=== Ski mountaineering ===
* 2004: 5th, [[Patrouille des Glaciers]] together with [[Lucia Näfen]] and [[Nathalie Etzensperger]]<ref>[http://live.pdg.ch/pdg04/pdf/rankinglistA.pdf ''2004 Patrouille des Glaciers'']{{dead link|date=July 2017 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>
* 2004: 10th (women ranking), Patrouille des Glaciers together with [[Andrea Salzmann]] and [[Bernarda Henzen]]<ref>[http://direct.pdg.ch/data/download/Objets/Id_343_Rang%20A2%20categorie_fr.pdf ''2010 Patrouille des Glaciers''] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100602020647/http://direct.pdg.ch/data/download/Objets/Id_343_Rang%20A2%20categorie_fr.pdf |date=2 June 2010 }}</ref>
